The use of parameter expansion in `noextract` is safe and purely declarative in this context. No data exfiltration or unauthorized network activity can occur during the sourcing phase. All constructs used are consistent with standard, safe AUR packaging practices.

While the `depends` array includes a versioned dependency on a related package and uses a Python version range, this is normal for Python packages and does not introduce risk during metadata parsing. The lack of `pkgver()` function means no dynamic version calculation occurs, so no remote content is fetched during this phase.
</details>
